issue_request: FHIR-53057 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested changing listed Financial Management resource element bindings from example or extensible to preferred across Claim, ClaimResponse, Coverage, CoverageEligibilityResponse, and PaymentNotice, with the final resolution extending the Claim and ClaimResponse changes to ExplanationOfBenefit.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied in source history. Commit e2419f5a3a applied related FHIR-49888/FHIR-49889 fundsreserve changes, commit 923a75117d included the first FHIR-53057 fundsreserve impact, and commit 149e0738568db284382c73482816e611c5b9ef4b changed the listed bindings to preferred. PR HL7/fhir#3874 merged those changes as 0057986e1b9fa6a371ab1ad07df17edd0724e629 after review.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists the affected FM resources as active build resources. ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit define reviewOutcome and adjudication bindings once and reuse them through contentReference for detail/addItem repetitions. Broader ex-* terminology replacement was not treated as part of this seed because FHIR-31039, which specifically asks to replace the procedure type example code system, remains Triaged, and the existing payment-type value set has different PaymentReconciliation semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was made. A scripted XML check over the active StructureDefinition files found all 34 FHIR-53057 target bindings present with strength preferred.
